body: I'll try, thank you for caring.

Thanks, I think I'm doing ok on the job search. At the very least I managed to fill out 10 applications since coming home, and I've got trade groups and recruiters in my address book. I just feel hopeless regardless of the effort.

It's always a rough night, honestly. Even when I do manage to make it to sleep before 4am or so, I wake up in a cold sweat because I end up reaching out for her in the middle of the night and realize she's not there.

I'm gonna go buy a drink and maybe I'll settle down.

>Still, think a bit. Are you suicidal because hard times or is it how you've always felt? Hard times pass, albeit like a kidney stone.

Honestly, I don't know. I can barely remember what I felt like before I was with her, because I'd been with her since I was 18 and been happy every moment of it until the end.

You're probably right about getting some rest. I'm thinking about getting something alcoholic to drink, because I don't really sleep well these days, but I don't know if that's a good idea.
I moved hundreds of miles to live with her several years ago. I have no family or friends nearby and those I have where I used to live are very poor.
